title: One Bakery Burned Down London
description: The Great Fire of London, September 1666.

scenes.narration: It started in one bakery, and it destroyed around thirteen thousand houses.
scenes.image_prompt: medieval London street of timber houses engulfed in flames at night, 1666

scenes.narration: It's September 2nd, 1666. Just after midnight, a fire breaks out on Pudding Lane in London.
scenes.image_prompt: small bakery on a narrow London lane with first flames at night, 17th century

scenes.narration: Houses are wooden, packed tightly together, and it's been a dry summer.
scenes.image_prompt: narrow 17th century London street with overhanging timber houses, daytime

scenes.narration: A strong east wind drives the flames across the city.
scenes.image_prompt: wind-driven fire spreading across rooftops of 17th century London, sparks

scenes.narration: People drag their belongings to the River Thames and escape by boat.
scenes.image_prompt: crowds loading belongings into small boats on the Thames with the city burning behind

scenes.narration: Old St Paul's Cathedral catches fire. Melted lead from its roof runs down the street.
scenes.image_prompt: old gothic St Paul's Cathedral burning with flames from the roof, night

scenes.narration: To stop it, houses are blown up with gunpowder to make firebreaks.
scenes.image_prompt: 17th century soldiers blowing up houses with gunpowder, explosion and dust

scenes.narration: After four days, it's out. Would you have stayed or fled? Tell me below.
scenes.image_prompt: smoking ruins of 17th century London at dawn, church towers standing
